title: Kalunga2016 – SSVEP Exo dataset
description: EEG recordings from 12 healthy participants performing a steady-state visually evoked potential (SSVEP) task for an assistive-robotics brain-computer interface. Participants seated in an electric wheelchair focused on LEDs flickering at 13, 17 and 21 Hz, or on a fixation point for a rest class, while 8-channel EEG was recorded at 256 Hz. The data support online, asynchronous SSVEP BCI development using Riemannian geometry.
methods_description: Eight EEG channels (Oz, O1, O2, POz, PO3, PO4, PO7, PO8) were recorded with a g.tec MobiLab amplifier at 256 Hz, referenced to the right mastoid. Each session consisted of 32 trials (8 per LED frequency and 8 rest trials). Trials lasted 5 s with 3 s pauses and began with an audio cue. A 20x30 cm panel with 3 groups of 4 LEDs provided the visual stimulation.
